# Export planning

**Status:** claimed
**Blocked by:** none
**Type:** discussion

## Questions

Should an empty inventory create a header-only CSV file, or refuse export
without creating a file? This blocks the export specification.

## Accepted answers

CSV is the agreed format. Columns are name and quantity.

## Evidence

The inventory is local and can contain zero items.
